newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

MOZAMBIQUE, June 17 - Nacala - Port working normally. No restrictions on berthing and sailing during night time. Draft restrictions 9.5 metres at general cargo berth and 14 metres at container berth. One tug available. Beira - General cargo berths working normally. Container terminal/other terminals - Working normally. 24 Hour berthing/sailing for vessels up to 140 metres loa, some restrictions for larger vessels and subject to prior arrangements with port captain. Maximum draft for 24 hour navigation 7.5 metres. Two tugs available. General access channel two wave-rider buoys have been deployed in the approach channel as follows wmon1 19 deg. 66.0460 s 36 deg. 01.6698 e and wmon2 19 deg. 62.6370 s 34 deg. 62.6497 e. Each buoy has an approximate diameter of 1 metre, with flashing orange light with a flash frequency of five one-second flashes every 36 seconds.

Maputo - 24 Hour berthing/sailing for vessels up to 120 metres loa, some restrictions for larger vessels and subject to prior arrangements with port captain. All berths working normally and expected to remain so. Draft restriction in the channel is 9.0 metres less 0.5 metres (ukc) plus the rise of tide. Maximum draft for 24 hour navigation is 9 metres.
NAMIBIA, June 17 - Walvis bay - Port working normally.

UNITED ARAB EMIRATES, June 8-14 - Dubai - No labour problems. 196 Vessels of which 77 containers, 11 general cargo, 2 general cargo/containers, 3 bulk carriers, 5 car carriers, 14 tankers, 6 naval vessels, 2 UAE naval vessels, 4 bunkering/under repair/taking stores etc., 3 dhows, 23 barges, 25 tugs, 2 passenger vessels, 1 chemical tanker, 16 supply boats, 1 VLCC, 1 refrigerated vessel. 4 Vessels loading at berth (3 containers, 1 tanker). 7 discharging at berth (5 general cargo, 2 tankers). 1 General cargo vessel bunkering, 11 under repair/laid-up (3 general cargo, 8 tankers). 44 Vessels due (25 containers, 12 general cargo, 7 tankers), with no delays expected.

YEMEN, June 15 - Hodeidah - Five vessels berthed of which 1 flour, 1 sugar, 3 bulk wheat. No vessels anchored. Berthing delays, containers/reefers no delays, general cargo (steel/timber/powder etc.) 2-3 days, bagged cargoes (sugar/rice/wheat flour etc.) 3-4 days, bulk wheat/corn 15-20 days. June 16 - Hodeidah - All berths occupied except nos. 1 and 2. 6 Vessels berthed of which 3 wheat, 1 flour, 1 containers, 1 sugar. 1 General cargo vessel anchored. Berthing delays, general cargo/containers up to 1 day, bagged cargoes up to 3 days, bulk cargoes up to 5 days. Mokha - One vessel berthed discharging wheat, no vessels anchored, no delays.
